links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading level of chatbot responses to bariatric patient questions
links.effect: Most chatbot responses required reading levels between 11th grade and college level, exceeding recommended patient reading levels.
links.quote: The readability of chatbot responses was assessed using Flesch-Kincaid scores, revealing that most responses required reading levels between the 11th grade and college level.

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot-generated patient education responses
links.effect: Most responses required 11th grade to college reading level; readability often exceeds recommended levels.
links.quote: However, readability often exceeds recommended levels, performance varies by model, occasional inaccuracies occur, and medicolegal considerations remain unresolved.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, comprehensiveness, readability, and reliability of various commercial LLM chatbots against clinician answers on 40 bariatric surgery patient questions, but does not test an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
